formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d₁ : Point) (d₂ : Point) (d₃ : Point) (AB : Line) (BC : Line) (AC : Line) (D₁₂ : Line) (D₂₃ : Line), ((formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) ∧ ((∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0) ∧ ((∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟)) → (∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧ (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:e:c' + Triangle.area △ f:c':g = Triangle.area △ a:b:c))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃: Line) (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) (h2 : formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) (h3 : (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0) (h4 : (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟) : ∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧ (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:e:c' + Triangle.area △ f:c':g = Triangle.area △ a:b:c) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (A : Point) (B : Point) (C : Point) (D : Point) (E : Point) (F : Point) (G : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (AE : Line) (AG : Line) (AD : Line) (CE : Line) (DG : Line), ((formParallelogram A B C D AB AD AE AG) ∧ (formQuadrilateral D C E G CD CE DG DE)) → ()
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (A B C D E F G : Point) (AB CD AE AG AD CE DG : Line) (h1 : formParallelogram A B C D AB AD AE AG) (h2 : formQuadrilateral D C E G CD CE DG DE)

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD CE : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∠ d:c:e)
nl_statement: To construct a rectilinear angle equal to a given rectilinear angle at a (given) point on a given straight-line.Let $AB$ be the given straight-line,  $A$ the (given) point on it, and  $DCE$ the given rectilinear angle.So it is required to construct a rectilinear angle equal to the given rectilinear angle $DCE$ at the (given) point $A$ on the given straight-line $AB$.  <prf> Thus, the rectilinear angle $FAG$,  equal to the  given rectilinear angle $DCE$, has been constructed at the (given) point $A$ on the given straight-line $AB$.
